verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Secureframe supports several frameworks individually (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS, CMMC/NIST 800-171), and its MCP server exposes controls and frameworks as objects. Nothing in the pack documents controls or evidence mapping across frameworks, SOC 2 work counting automatically toward ISO 27001 or HIPAA, or any display of the overlap. Cross-framework mapping is a fair axis for a compliance automation platform, so the absence of evidence is 'none', not 'na'.
